scope: Research-only caveat resolution under data/research/candidate-trails/ostkustleden/. No runtime source, generated output, package, script or shared app data was edited.

sourceCheckSummary.method: Main-thread follow-up source pass over current official/maintainer pages plus synthesis of existing section research files.

officialSourcesRechecked.label: Naturkartan: Övernattningsstuga Stjärneberg
officialSourcesRechecked.finding: Visible page text lists Stjärneberg cabin inventory, well about 75 m away, boil-water recommendation, no outdoor fires and standard fees. The earlier bed-bug closure and arsenic wording was not reproduced.

officialSourcesRechecked.label: Naturkartan: Övernattningsstuga Hällveberg
officialSourcesRechecked.finding: Confirms Hällveberg is the current map name, Hedvigsberg the older name, no electricity, well/dry toilet, boil-water recommendation and no outdoor fires.

officialSourcesRechecked.label: Naturkartan: Övernattningsstuga Lilla Hycklinge
officialSourcesRechecked.finding: Confirms water in the house, toilet between red and yellow buildings, grill ring usable only when no stricter municipal fire ban applies and standard fees.

officialSourcesRechecked.label: Döderhults Naturskyddsförening: Ostkustleden
officialSourcesRechecked.finding: Confirms the 16 mil, 8-stage ring, general cabin network, stage distances, stage narratives, bathing notes, transport links and general allemansrätten guidance.

officialSourcesRechecked.label: Oskarshamn tourism: Ostkustleden
officialSourcesRechecked.finding: Confirms the 16 mil, 8-stage closed ring and says overnight cabins are open year-round in broad public tourism text.

sourcePrecedence: Current official facility/section pages and maintainer pages checked on 2026-04-29 take precedence for static research decisions.
Official GPX/PDF/API linework is preferred for route geometry, but raw multi-track order is not trusted when section research documents duplicate, reversed or mid-route pieces.
Official PDFs, OSM relations and route apps are secondary checks for distance and continuity, not replacement geometry when official GPX is repairable.
Third-party field reports are used for terrain, route-finding and currentness cautions, not for unverified facility availability unless corroborated by official sources.
endpointPolicy: Keep official GPX endpoints and official cabin/facility markers as separate evidence when there is a gap.
Do not snap to a cabin marker unless a separate official access leg or normalization decision later supports it.
Naturkartan route-page markers may be mid-route or endpoint-adjacent; use GPX endpoints and facility markers instead.
distancePolicy: Use the current official section page distance as canonical display unless a documented duplicate-geometry artifact clearly explains the discrepancy.
For Etapp 5, treat Naturkartan 21.4 km as duplicate-linework inflated and retain about 19 km display context with repaired official GPX length about 18.734 km for normalization.
Store computed GPX lengths as geometry metadata, not as silent replacement for official display values.
facilityPolicy: Only import POIs with source-backed coordinates. Narrative-only or locality-proxy POIs remain pending or suppressed from default import.
Cabin-yard water, toilets, fireplaces and grills without separate source-backed coordinates should be modeled as cabin metadata or clustered subfacilities, not independent precision POIs.
Natural swimming waters are not drinking-water sources.
Water sources with boil/currentness caveats must not be presented as unqualified potable water.
accessPolicy: Off-route shops, harbors, food, lodging, taxi/Närtrafik and bus fallback points are access/service metadata unless a sourced spur geometry exists.
KLT/Närtrafik service patterns are publication-time checks, even where stop coordinates are researched.
rulesPolicy: Fire bans, hunting notices, forestry operations, cabin availability, seasonal water, bathing-water status and transit service remain publication-time checks.

Protected-area, Natura 2000, biotopskydd and water-protection rules should not be applied as route-touch rules unless a GIS overlay confirms intersection or an official source states the route passes through the area.

resolvedCaveats.resolution: The earlier closed-cabin/arsenic claim was not reproducible from current official Stjärneberg Naturkartan, Döderhult or Oskarshamn pages on 2026-04-29. Candidate data should not mark Stjärneberg closed or carry a static arsenic warning. Keep cabin availability and well quality as publication-time checks, with boil-water wording from current official text.
Endpoint/cabin gaps and route-page pin mismatches are not research blockers. Preserve them as metadata and normalize route geometry from documented GPX sequence/repair instructions.
Distance conflicts are handled by keeping official display distance, secondary rounded distances and computed GPX lengths in separate fields. Etapp 5 has a special duplicate-geometry artifact note.
Use Hällveberg as current display name and Hedvigsberg/Hälveberg spellings as source aliases.
Off-route service clusters are access metadata; optional narrative POIs without exact source-backed coordinates remain pending or suppressed from default import.
Where exact water/toilet/fireplace coordinates are not sourced separately, keep them as cabin metadata or clustered subfacilities instead of blocking route normalization.

remainingPublicationTimeChecks: KLT/Närtrafik schedules, stop service patterns and seasonal/weekend availability.
Cabin availability, group booking, fees and seasonal access at all endpoint cabins before user-facing publication.
Current water quality and reliability for Nynäs, Lönhult, Krokstorp, Mörtfors, Stjärneberg, Lilla Laxemar, Hällveberg, Lilla Hycklinge and Stensjö by refill claims.
Same-day municipal/county fire bans and fire-risk warnings.
Current hunting notices and local active-hunting signage.
Forestry/felling notices and on-site passability, especially Etapp 1 near Nynäs and Etapp 6 notices A 54522-2023, A 18318-2026 and A 18330-2026.
Seasonal café/service hours for Stensjö by, Tilias and off-route food/lodging/service clusters.
remainingGisOrCoordinateChecks: GIS overlays for Bråbygden Natura 2000, Krokshult reserve context, Misterhults skärgård reserve/Natura 2000 C-areas, Stamsjövägen reserve, Fårbo water-protection area, Virån Natura 2000, biotopskydd SK 568-2007 and other water-protection boundaries.

Exact optional POI coordinates before import: Humlenäs/Hummeln small swim access, Småland 'Chinese wall', Tvingen/Storyttern swim access, Karlsfors mill/waterfall, Skälshult mill, Krokstorpssjön swim point, Hålviken beach/old port, Kallsebo quarries, Trollklinten, Tjustgölen swim, Bussvik/Kärrsvik/Ekerum swim/cultural points, Djurvadsnäs cairns, Bredviksberget, Stålglo, Uthammar quarry waste piles, Gammal-Näs/Ny-Näs/Södra Uvö, Tilias, Nybo göl, Långsjön and Virån/Åmötsberget.

importReadinessDecision.reason: All static research caveats that can be resolved without inventing coordinates have a policy or corrected source decision. Runtime import still needs a separate normalization-planning task, GIS overlays where route-touch rules matter, and publication-time checks for unstable availability/safety facts.
importReadinessDecision.recommendedNextSafeStep: Run a normalization-planning review within data/research/candidate-trails/ostkustleden/ only; do not integrate into runtime app data until explicitly requested.
